chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from some of his companions, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
He said to me: The prayer of the day is sixteen rakʿahs; whichever part of the day you wish—if you wish, in its beginning; and if you wish, in its middle; and if you wish, in its end.

key_terms.صَلَاةُ النَّهَارِ: the supererogatory prayer associated with the daytime

ai.seo_question: When can the daytime nawafil be performed according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the nawafil of the daytime consist of sixteen rakʿahs. It indicates flexibility in their timing, allowing them to be performed at the beginning, middle, or end of the day.
